title: Zinc–bromine batteries revisited: unlocking liquid-phase redox chemistry for next-generation energy storage
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02219C, Review Article
Jiaxin Meng, Guozhen Zhang, Le Pang, Qiyu Liu, Jianuo Yao, Yaoyu Wang, He Liu, Cong Guo, Weizhai Bao, Jingfa Li, Faxing Wang, Feng Yu, Hongxia Wang
This review highlights recent progress in zinc–bromine batteries, including advances in anode and cathode materials, electrolyte engineering, and interface design, offering insights for next-generation energy storage systems.
